It sounds like you're looking to connect with someone in a specific field to learn about their career journey — that's a great way to explore whether a path might be right for you. A great starting point would be reaching out through your school's career center, alumni networks, or professional organizations related to the field you're interested in. Many people are happy to share their experiences with students.

You could also try platforms like LinkedIn to find professionals and send a polite, brief message explaining that you're a student interested in learning about their career path. Informational interviews are very common, and most people are flattered to be asked. When you do connect, asking about their courses, how long they studied, and what they enjoy about their job are all wonderful questions. Good luck with your search!
